title: feat(polli-cli): add Bloom harness
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
## Summary
- Adds `polli harness bloom on|status|off`.
- Creates a dedicated key in Bloom's existing `.env` configuration while preserving unrelated values.
- Documents installation and the reversible setup.

## Test plan
- [x] `npm test` (110 tests)
- [x] `npm run build`
- [x] Clean Bloom 0.1.3 install, version, and help
- [x] Authenticated Bloom text request returned `BLOOM_OK`

Upstream startup issue fixed in [Bloom #1](https://github.com/Ilm-Alan/bloom-cli/issues/1).

gist.headline: Bloom gets a hive key
gist.blurb: Polli CLI can now set up Bloom with one reversible command. It tucks a dedicated Pollinations key into Bloom’s existing .env without trampling the rest of the garden.
gist.summary: Added `polli harness bloom on|status|off`, which configures a dedicated Pollinations key in Bloom CLI’s existing `.env` while preserving unrelated configuration and provides documented reversible setup.
gist.impact: Bloom 0.1.3 users can enable, inspect, or remove Pollinations-backed text access from the Polli CLI, with their existing `.env` values left intact.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Bloom as a small flowering command-line garden: a retro terminal opens a `.env` seed packet and carefully plants a glowing dedicated API key beside already-grown configuration flowers. Polli, wearing a tiny gardener tool belt, checks that each neighboring plant remains undisturbed; subtle `ON`, `STATUS`, and `OFF` signposts make the reversible harness commands visible.
